title: Resident execution uses an immutable runtime capsule
summary: The installed resident service executes from a versioned local runtime capsule, while the normal repository checkout remains only a Git handle. This prevents a stale/dirty checkout from silently changing daemon code.
invariants: Installing an existing capsule with different content is a collision.
Systemd ExecStart points at the capsule launcher, not at a mutable package tree in the ordinary checkout.
The ordinary checkout may remain dirty/stale throughout installation, execution and publication.

provenance.claim: Immutable capsule installation and service launcher selection.
